label: SIMULATED
question: Does the witnessed-record validator reject every cheat in an adversarial corpus — and does it pass the compliant record?
assumptions: every cheat is one mutation of the compliant example record — the corpus proves the named contract catches the named cheat, nothing more
limits: The validator proves record integrity, not truth: a fabricated but internally consistent measurement with an independent witness passes — the witness, the raw-data hash and the lab are the control (IEEE 323 §4.4).
Schema + platform laws only; no physics is validated by any record format.
house_rules: pump/treatment electricity stays separate from recovered output
redistributed flow is never counted as new heat
box fractions are never probabilities (CLAIM-TRACE S1)
analysis alone is not qualification — zero measured duty hours (IEEE Std 323)
